children: UK production facilities provider's H1 revenue fell 4.6% amid weaker film and TV market
Pretax loss widened; Adjusted EBITDA dropped due to lower revenue and operational deleverage
Company expects FY26 results below current market expectations, no interim dividend declared
Company expects FY26 results to be below current market expectations
Facilities by ADF expects H2 FY26 to be stronger, in line with prior years
Order book and pipeline for FY27 is 4.5% ahead of prior year at same point
WEAK MARKET - Co said revenue decline reflected a 15.6% drop in UK film and HETV production spend
HIGHER COSTS - Margin dilution driven by increased people costs and higher fuel prices, per management
COST ACTIONS - Co said it launched further integration and cost-saving measures to improve efficiency
